items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Norman Granz was connected with Chico O'Farrill... Mario Bauza and Charlie Parker and Norman Granz we got together... he took Charlie Parker to listen to the band to see if he liked to record with us. So he liked.

ctx.x: Now,you did some nice Mercury recordings, you know, "Hall of the Mambo King", "At Sunrise" and that. How soon later or who approached you with the idea of bringing the Machito orchestra together with Charlie Parker?
Okay. Do you remember what happened or how it came about?
